newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end higher as Dow recoups sharp losses.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end higher as Dow recoups sharp losses.

text.p: Leading UK shares ended with moderate gains on Friday as the Dow recovered from an initial 70-point deficit as London markets closed, but dealers said the equity markets on both sides of the Atlantic remains vulnerable.

The long-awaited U.S. employment report flagged signs of wage inflation, and reinforced the view that the Federal Reserve will tighten credit further at its next policy meeting on May 20, dealers and economists said.
The benchmark FTSE 100 share index settled 22.0 points higher at 4,236.6, as advancers led decliners 71 to 25.
